content: {"praised":["Pacino delivers powerful performance as Tony Montana.","Film is an American classic with strong dramatic structure.","Tony Montana’s character is compelling and charismatic.","Movie showcases vivid Miami setting and drug‑lore atmosphere.","Soundtrack enhances the film’s intense tone."],"criticized":["Acting is over‑the‑top and unconvincing.","Latin accents feel inauthentic and poorly executed.","Storyline is dumb and poorly paced.","Film is cheesy and lacks depth.","Overall quality is awful and disappointing."]}
